title: Read an immutable evidence revision
responsibility: Build a source context pinned to an exact commit and recognize safe stored evidence paths.

inputs.name: hubPinnedSource.base
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubPinnedSource.commit
inputs.description: Full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit ID that the source must resolve unchanged.

outputs.name: hubPinnedSource
outputs.description: New context for the exact commit/tree, sharing source/cache and retaining the original authorization identity while changing requestedRef.

outputs.name: hubEvidencePath
outputs.description: True for a nonempty slash-separated path with no empty, dot or parent segments, backslashes or control/delete characters.

errors.name: invalid-evidence-revision
errors.description: Commit format is invalid or the source resolves it to a different commit.
